title: CARD: Closing the Teacher-Student Loop for Adversarial Robustness Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19911v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adversarial robustness distillation typically treats a robust teacher as a fixed knowledge source and transfers robustness to a compact student in a one-way manner. This paradigm terminates teacher-student interaction once the student is distilled, thereby discarding potentially useful feedback from the distilled student. However, exploiting such feedback is nontrivial because indiscriminate weak-to-strong transfer may propagate student errors to the teacher. To address this issue, we propose Cyclic Adversarial Robustness Distillation (CARD), a closed-loop framework that turns the distilled student into a feedback source for refining the robust teacher and subsequently transfers the teacher gains back to the same student. CARD first performs strong-to-weak adversarial distillation and then uses reliability-enhanced student feedback to refine the robust teacher. translated_title: CARD：闭合师生循环以实现对抗鲁棒性蒸馏
translated_abstract: 对抗鲁棒性蒸馏通常将鲁棒教师模型视为固定的知识来源，并以单向方式将鲁棒性传递给紧凑的学生模型。这种范式在学生模型完成蒸馏后便终止了师生之间的交互，从而丢弃了来自蒸馏后学生模型的潜在有用反馈。然而，利用这种反馈并非易事，因为不加区分的弱到强知识迁移可能会将学生的错误传播给教师。为解决这一问题，我们提出了循环对抗鲁棒性蒸馏（CARD），这是一个闭环框架，它将蒸馏后的学生转化为反馈来源，用于改进鲁棒教师模型，随后将教师的增益迁移回同一个学生。CARD首先执行强到弱的对抗蒸馏，然后使用可靠性增强的学生反馈来改进鲁棒教师模型。该改进过程将逆向对抗学生反馈与师生（信息）相结合……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出闭环循环对抗鲁棒性蒸馏框架CARD，将蒸馏后的学生模型作为反馈来源改进教师模型，再将教师增益回传给学生，从而突破传统单向蒸馏范式并提升对抗鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: CARD introduces a closed-loop adversarial robustness distillation framework that treats the distilled student as a feedback source to refine the robust teacher and then transfers the teacher's gains back to the student, moving beyond the traditional one-way distillation paradigm.
